adaptation_notes: sdl3_bind_allocation() must run before any other SDL call, including SDL_SetHint, which allocates. To pick the headless video driver for probes, set the SDL_VIDEO_DRIVER environment variable instead of calling SDL_SetHint.
If the engine already installs its own SDL memory functions, route them through am::alloc instead of replacing them.
SDL_SetLogOutputFunction allocates; that is fine because it runs after the memory phase.
The check compares the headers the glue was compiled against with the library linked at runtime.
